blocking_checks.rule: Normal status-only and explicit archive-move drift converge in one apply with authority bytes unchanged.
Every named invalid input fails before managed target commit.
Every covered caught write failure restores all managed targets when recovery facilities work.
Rollback failure preserves truthful recovery material and explicit recovery succeeds without manifest parsing.
Retry, no-op, mtime, exit, and diagnostic semantics match disk facts.
Full regression and independent final-candidate review pass.

advisory_checks.rule: Consider crash and power-loss recovery only under a separately authorized contract.
Consider external-writer locking only under a separately authorized contract.

claim_ceiling: Passing G-001 establishes caught-error recovery for the tested local-filesystem paths in this repository; it does not establish crash consistency, concurrency safety, downstream deployment, or publication.
